summary: The first Arbos release: the Rust kernel and the desktop under one name, with every open branch folded in — OpenRouter-first models, permission modes, MCP servers, hooks, memory, skills as slash commands, search with citations, screenshots and recordings, sandboxed bash, remote and worktree children, and a headless CLI.
new: Arbos.app: the desktop is Arbos, not Cydonia, in the bundle, the menu bar, and the code
OpenRouter-first model backend, `arbos-kernel setup`, and Settings › Model
Permission modes per agent: auto, ask, plan
Custom agent definitions (`spawn kind=<name>`), worktree isolation, and children on other machines over SSH
MCP servers per place, hooks.toml policy, durable memory, and skills as slash commands
Search with numbered citations across Exa, Brave, Tavily, OpenRouter web, and DuckDuckGo
Screenshot and screen-recording tools with artifact cards in the transcript
Sandboxed bash (bubblewrap on Linux, sandbox-exec on macOS) and a secret tool that keeps keys out of the transcript
Sub-agent status lines, a Tasks rail, Working and PRs pills, cost per turn, and streamed job output
Headless `arbos-kernel run`, `answer`, and `attach`; a timestamped kernel.log
Voice over a self-hosted speech server
fixed: Folding the sidebar no longer covers the chat title
The plan strip and the composer share both edges
A turn with no API key ends the transcript instead of replaying forever
Graceful stop on Ctrl-C, incremental transcript tailing, and a dozen QA fixes to focus, plans, and writes

summary: The turn in flight carries a name and what it spends, the agent's model and mode move into its menu, and an open project reconciles whatever lands in .arbos.
new: Put bezel's thinking orbs on the working turn and its row
Rebuild the menus on bezel 0.1.8, and describe the slash commands
Meter the context in the agent menu and keep it across a load
Draw the permission request as an alert and the steer as a message
Name the turn in flight and count what it is spending
Select and copy text out of the transcript
Pick the agent's model and mode from its menu, and meter the context
Make the watch delay a setting in Settings > Performance
Watch each open project's .arbos and reconcile what lands in it
fixed: Capture an agent's stderr instead of inheriting it
Close an agent's connection before killing its process

new: The product site, a macOS bundle, the menu bar and settings
Rebuild the sidebar around one ordered list per project
Gate agents and open each project where it was left
Persist every session and rebuild the chrome on bezel's tokens
Turn the app into a per-project workspace
Add per-project boards and articles, and a settings window
ACP coverage, registry installs, and a GPUI client
changed: Rebuild the desktop client on bezel and cacp
